# Missed No More Pro

> Missed No More Pro is an AI receptionist and AI answering service for small local service businesses (roughly 1-15 employees). It answers business calls 24/7, quotes exact prices computed from the owner's approved rates, books jobs on the calendar, texts customers, and logs every lead in a built-in CRM. Plans start at $50/month with a 7-day free trial.

## What it does

- Answers every call 24/7 in the business's name, in a natural voice. It never claims to be human and says it is an AI assistant if asked.
- Qualifies the caller one question at a time and screens spam calls.
- Quotes exact prices. Every number is computed server-side from the owner's approved rates, service zones, and real driving distance; the AI never invents a price. Requests outside the rules are captured and flagged for the team.
- Books, cancels, and reschedules appointments on Google Calendar, only inside owner-approved hours, and sends text confirmations and reminders.
- Warm-transfers upset, complex, or "get me a person" calls to a real team member, briefing them first so the caller never repeats themselves; otherwise it takes a detailed message and alerts the team by text.
- Sends missed-call text-backs and follow-ups. A2P 10DLC registered; STOP/HELP handled automatically.
- Built-in CRM: contacts, lead pipeline, customer timeline, call transcripts and summaries, payment requests, dispatch board, and an AI business assistant that answers questions about the business.
- Website chat widget and two-way AI texting from the same AI.
- Towing and roadside: quotes tows by dispatch zone, hook fee, and per-mile rate, and can find nearby shops when the caller has no drop-off in mind.

## Who it is for

Local service businesses where a missed call means a lost job. Businesses that go out to the customer: towing and roadside assistance, locksmiths, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, garage doors, pest control, landscaping, cleaning, restoration, mobile mechanics, appliance repair, and handyman services. Businesses customers visit: hair and nail salons, barbershops, spas, lash and tattoo studios, pet groomers, veterinary clinics, and auto repair and tire shops. For businesses customers visit, the AI books appointments and never asks for the caller's address.

## Pricing

- Starter: $50/month, 200 AI minutes, 1 user
- Growth: $100/month, 400 AI minutes, 3 users
- Professional: $200/month, 800 AI minutes, 10 users, dispatch board and Zapier/Make
- Enterprise: custom
- Annual billing saves 20%. 7-day free trial on every plan (card required).
- Hard usage caps with no overage charges: at the limit, calls forward to the owner's phone.
- No paid add-ons today: every current AI capability is included in the plan structure above.
- First 10 paying businesses lock in their price for life while their subscription stays active.

## Setup

- Guided setup takes about 15 minutes: services, hours, service area, greeting. Owners can upload a price sheet or FAQ document instead of typing it in, and approve everything before going live.
- Keep an existing business number by forwarding calls (all calls, or only unanswered ones), or claim a new local number from the dashboard.

## Try it

- Live demo line: (440) 644-2423. Call or text to hear the AI receptionist answer as a sample home-services business. No signup needed.
- Free trial: https://missednomorepro.com/signup

## Company

- Founded by Josh Millsaps, who runs a roadside-assistance business and built the system to stop missing calls on the job. It still answers that business's phone today.
- Early-stage and onboarding founding customers. Based in Ohio, serving businesses in the United States.
- Sales: hello@missednomorepro.com. Support: support@missednomorepro.com
